scope: Small exact onset-delta/gate timing model, predictive comparison on representation-inspected but previously predictive-unscored Brahms580
models: empirical joint pair with uniform joint prior
factorized empirical marginals with uniform marginal priors
comparison: Both assign probability to exactly the same (delta,gate) outcome space. Report timing-pair NLL per event and unsupported outcomes. No pitch likelihood, no predictive task equivalence to old REST/HOLD models.
projection: For onset-sorted notes, delta is from previous onset (first fromtick0), gate is noteoff-onset. ExactPPQ384 conversion only; no quantization. Pitch and velocities retained separately for source preservation.
selection: No model tuning or choosing a winner to refit after580scores. Preserve all results. Source is now inspected, not untouched or a blind benchmark.
admission: Reviewed580composition/edition/MIDIrights, independent composer/contributor from oldtrain4. Exact/nearinterval scan before scoring; any exact8match or wholeinterval normalized similarity>=0.90 requires review and blocks scoring.
generation: Training pitches only, target24quarters(8bars6/8), max256notes,maxpolyphony3, active samepitch exclusion, no clipping, bounded attempts and failures retained. Both models use same constraints and seeds0..9.
limits: No human preference, copyright clearance, broader generalization, symbolic ornament understanding, or new model training on580/583. Fixedtiming distribution not a learned melody/phrase structure model. NoGPU or paid operations.
